# Research cycle template

Follow [GRS](../research-standard.md); this template does not redefine its rules.

- Cycle ID / standard version / status / owner:
- Incumbent, parent receipts and relevant prior failures/trials:
- Add stage or improve stage; hypothesis, mechanism and one change:
- Inputs, source/license, data/code/config/dependency identities:
- Universe, dates, capital, timing, actions, costs and financing:
- Frozen plan, controls, primary criterion/materiality/guardrails:
- Information availability, label maturity, fitting/evaluation and prior exposure:
- Attempt/resource/deadline limits, reservations, retries and stopping:
- Every attempted case: UTC times, status, command, exit and artifacts:
- Manifest and independent audit outcomes; missing/failed evidence:
- Full/annual/temporal results; supporting and contradictory findings:
- Disposition and reason; unchanged incumbent / provisional challenger:
- Short lesson, report eligibility and link if warranted:
- Next uncertainty and evidence condition; no automatic continuation:

For new cycles, capture and validate the [versioned experiment receipt](../research-standard.md#experiment-receipt-contract) before closure. Link actual names/run/build identities, failed/partial attempts, artifact hashes, validation outcome and single-leaderboard disposition. Historical records remain unchanged.
